entities.name: Fall of Castle Melmereth
entities.description: An event near the end of 4195 AR in which Jared Carthalion and his crew brought down Ravidel.

entities.name: Castle Melmereth
entities.description: Ancestral Carthalion holding seized by Ravidel.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: Son of Adam Carthalion who sought to reclaim his ancestral home.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Controlled Castle Melmereth and served a darker force.

entities.name: Adam Carthalion
entities.description: Jared's father who made a pact with Ravidel and turned against him.

entities.name: Nikko
entities.description: Jared's companion who fell to Narok.

entities.name: Liana of Minorad
entities.description: Joined Jared and detonated the artifacts.

entities.name: Ezer
entities.description: Jared's former mentor, fatally struck by debris.

entities.name: Narok
entities.description: Ravidel's orcish enforcer, killed by Jared.

entities.name: Black Lotus
entities.description: Crushed by Jared to summon a Shivan Dragon.

entities.name: Shivan Dragon
entities.description: Dragon summoned by the Black Lotus.

entities.name: Chromium Rhuell
entities.description: Ravidel's old companion, whom he mistook the dragon for.

entities.name: Corondor
entities.description: Land whose control by Ravidel was shattered.

entities.name: Arathoxia
entities.description: Ruined city where Jared grew up.

events.summary: Jared, with Yorgo and Nikko, resolves to confront Ravidel and reclaim Castle Melmereth, armed with a Black Lotus and spell scroll.
events.quote: resolved to confront Ravidel and reclaim his ancestral home

events.summary: Ravidel reveals the truth of Jared's father's treachery; Nikko falls to Narok, whom Jared kills.
events.quote: Nikko fell to Narok , Ravidel's orcish enforcer, before Jared killed the orc in a fit of wrath.

events.summary: Jared crushes the Black Lotus, summoning a Shivan Dragon that ruins the castle.
events.quote: Jared crushed the Black Lotus, summoning a fearsome Shivan Dragon

events.summary: Ezer is fatally struck by falling debris.
events.quote: Ezer was fatally struck by falling debris

events.summary: Liana leads survivors out and detonates the remaining artifacts, reducing the castle to rubble.
Ravidel survives but loses control of Corondor; Jared departs as a Wayfarer.
events.quote: his control over Corondor was shattered

relations.quote: Jared killed the orc in a fit of wrath
Jared and Liana shared a brief, bittersweet kiss
